verdict.rationale: Retell explicitly documents connecting single/multi-prompt agents to remote MCP servers so the agent can call the server's tools during a live call/chat, directly matching the story of plugging in MCP servers as tool sources mid-call. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of multi-tool MCP server usage in production and details on limits (e.g., number of tools, latency impact) beyond first-party docs.
